AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Agroforestry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Pest control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Digestive systems of animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

1. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

2. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

5. D — Ice melting to water

6. C — 100 °C

7. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.

10. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
